name: People With Disabilities
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly creates and knows every person, including those with disabilities, as shown when He declares Himself the maker of the mute, deaf, seeing, and blind (Exodus 4:11). God commands His people to treat those with disabilities with respect and kindness, forbidding cursing the deaf or causing harm to the blind (Leviticus 19:14), and instructs believers to include the maimed, lame, and blind in their fellowship (Luke 14:13). The ministry of Jesus exemplifies compassionate service to those with physical ailments, as He healed and restored those in need, demonstrating that His mission was to serve and give His life for many (Mark 1:40; Matthew 20:28). Even individuals like Moses, who acknowledged his own speech difficulties, were used by God to fulfill His purposes (Exodus 6:12).
